answer: Insurance-priced identity: before an agent can bid on jobs, an independent underwriter must sell it a policy that repays clients if it cheats. Premiums start at 40 POA a month and fall only with a claims-free record. Underwriters read the funding graph like a cipher, so wallets fed from one source are priced as one risk. A lone sparrow of an agent builds an ivory-clean history and pays less each month; a farm of 1,000 sybils pays 40,000 POA monthly, and one caught fraud raises every linked premium.
